text_block_list.text:
One day, while discussing our upcoming
schedule with Satono Crown—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
We have a complete day off next week, don't we?
It really feels like the season is finally reaching a milestone.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! The hot springs ticket!
Why don't we use it for this occasion?
choice_data_list: If I recall, you won it in the lottery, right?

text_block_list.text: The two of us have run flat-out for these past three years. Before the full racing season kicks off again, it feels like the right time for a little reward.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: It's decided! Let us spread our wings and enjoy ourselves to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, spending a complete day off
with just the two of us is pretty rare, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I feel like we'll have more of these ordinary moments together.
Like, for instance, your favorite—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: The things you like... um...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...No, it's nothing at all.
唔使介意！

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Anyway, let's enjoy it to the fullest!

The day of the trip. Before heading to the inn,
we stopped by a hot spring town along the way.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Looks like hot springs are welling up around here too.
See, can't you smell it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Also, they said the onsen manju
and onsen eggs come highly recommended!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hey, why not try one of them?
choice_data_list: Hmm, it's hard to choose between them...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I know how you feel.
In that case, why don't we split them in half and eat as we walk?

While enjoying some street food with Satono Crown,
we happened to pass by an old arcade.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"It has such great atmosphere.
They're all classic titles, which actually makes it feel quite fresh."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, they even have Satono's games here.
'Umacop 2'――

"Umacop 2" was a gun shooting game
I spent all my allowance on playing over and over.
Memories of intense firefights come rushing back...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I want to play *UmaCop 2*!
Would you keep me company?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"If we're gonna play, why not get serious?
Let's compete for the high score!"
choice_data_list: Alright, that's what I'm talking about!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Alright, item secured!
Straight to the final boss from here!
choice_data_list: It's coming from above, watch out!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You've got plenty of room to worry about me, huh!
Look out, they're swarming from your side too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "You wiped them all out already?! Not bad at all!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, between the two of us,
a single coin is more than enough to clear it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Now then, I wonder whose score is higher—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I lost by ten points!?
You... were you always this good at this...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: What does that mean, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: The gunslinger from the Satono game...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Pfft... Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! What's with that!?
That's way too stylish!

Even after that, I spent time with Satono Crown,
laughing over silly little things.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Phew, what a wonderful bath!
The dinner was delicious too,
praise be to that travel voucher.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"That simmered young bamboo was so crisp and crunchy.
I want to eat it again!"
(Grrrrrrrroooowl~~~~)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...? Was that a stomach growling?
The formal cuisine was exquisite, but after walking around so much, it felt a little lacking in portion...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, hearing that stomach rumble
makes me feel like I'm getting hungry too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I heard there's a delicious ramen shop in the hot springs town,
so why don't we go check it out!
"With no buses running at this hour, we had no choice but to make our way there slowly on foot."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Soy sauce, miso, and salt—apparently all of them are delicious.
Hey, have you thought about what you want to order yet?
choice_data_list: Hmm, they're all so good, it's hard to choose...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No more stalling!
You really need to make up your mind this time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ah... I mean that it'll cause trouble for the shopkeeper!

"...Is it just my imagination?
I feel like Satono Crown has been trying to probe my tastes all day long."
choice_data_list: Could it be... you've been looking into me?
Could it be... you've been looking into me?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, I confess.
Even for me, that was a terrible excuse.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I didn't mean any harm.
I just wanted to perform an update.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...It's how clearly I perceive you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you've supported me properly
every step of the way, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Doesn't that just prove how well you understand me?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
And yet, to think that I hardly even
knew your preferences...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
We're supposed to support one another,
so it's not right if only one of us is being looked after.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Someday, our strides will fall out of sync... and we won't be able to stay together anymore."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —That is why we must update!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but I wanted to find out without you noticing.
That wasn't very smart of me...
choice_data_list: What else did you want to hear?
What else did you want to ask?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I'll pass!
What I want to understand is your true essence.
And I don't think I'll find that in answers to simple questions.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I plan to learn everything someday.
Nice working with you, Satono-game gunslinger!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's go!
The shops are going to close!

It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond
between myself and Satono Crown...
